d:
Relive the timeless romance of Kaho Na Kaho from Murder in stunning 8K/4K. Featuring the soulful voice of Amir Jamal, this iconic melody composed by Anu Malik and penned by Sayeed Quadri brings back the unforgettable chemistry of Emraan Hashmi and Mallika Sherawat.
Credits:
Song – Kaho Na Kaho
Movie – Murder (2004)
Singer – Amir Jamal
Music Composer – Anu Malik
Lyricist – Sayeed Quadri
Starring – Emraan Hashmi & Mallika Sherawat
